Prices & booking

Choose your visit, see the price straight away and book in a few clicks. Guiding fee only: the château's entrance ticket is paid on site.

Prices

Clear packages, for one person or a whole group. Prices for the guided tour, in euros.

Classic tour

Voltaire’s château and gardens, in about 1 hour 15 minutes.

  • €28 per person
  • €14 ages 7–17
  • free under 7
Choose

Private tour

Your guide just for you and your companions, at the time you choose.

  • €170 flat rate · up to 6 people
Choose

Group rate

For groups of 10 people or more, up to 30 per guide.

  • €20 per person · groups from 10 people
  • minimum €200
Choose

Saturday, 9:30 am – 12:30 pm

Saturday: château & market

The château and its gardens, then a guided stroll through the Ferney-Voltaire market to the statue of the “patriarch”, before the market closes at 1 pm.

  • €45 per person · from 4 people
  • €36 per person · groups from 10 people
Choose

Thematic tour

The Enlightenment, Voltaire and Geneva, literature: a tour prepared on request for your group.

  • €39 per person · on request
  • €28 per person · groups from 10 people
  • minimum €280

Companies

Team building, incentives and tours around your events.

  • from €390 · on quote
